title: Kitchen Funnels Set 3 Pack,Funnel for Kitchen Use Filling Bottles,Silicone Funnel Collapsible,Small Funnels for Filling Small Bottles
description:
About this item
Food-Grade Kitchen Accessories：The Silicone funnel is flexible and not prone to deformation. The Kitchen Funnel is heat-resistant, ranging from -40°C to 240°C. It can come into direct contact with food. There's no need to worry that the material of "plastic funnels" might affect the health of your family members.
Funnels for Filling Bottles Size：The maximum height of the Small Funnel when unfolded is 2.95 inches, and the width of the wide opening is 3.54 inches. The Mini Funnel is an absolute must-have kitchen tool accessory for moms!
Portable and Space-Saving：With a foldable design, it can be expanded for use. You can fold and store the silicone funnel. After storage, you can hang it on the wall or keep it in a drawer. The three foldable silicone funnels take up less space than one regular plastic funnel after being stored.
Easy to Use and Clean：This is a small kitchen tool for cooking and baking. The food-grade funnel only requires a small amount of soap added to warm water or can be put in the dishwasher. Let the machine help you clean the funnels.
Worry-Free Service：If you're not satisfied with our funnel set, please feel free to contact us. We will do our best to solve the problem for you.
